VAL-GRAPH-005.evidence: Live test: Request 1 (cache miss) TTFT=4316ms, Request 2 (cache hit, same system prompt) TTFT=625ms, ratio=0.145 (<= 0.80 threshold). Prior test (prefix_caching_test.json): First TTFT=15622ms, Second TTFT=137ms, ratio=0.009. Both confirm cache hit reduces TTFT to <= 80% of cache miss TTFT.

VAL-GRAPH-006.evidence: Live VRAM check with --max-model-len 32768: GPU[0]=29.76GB/31.98GB (93.0%), GPU[1]=29.80GB (93.2%), GPU[2]=29.82GB (93.2%), GPU[3]=29.80GB (93.2%). Reduced max-model-len frees ~87.5% of KV cache memory versus the maximum context, enabling the server to run at all on MI100.
